scope: Johnson County basic-needs navigation, food, housing, legal, safety, maternal-child nutrition, senior, and youth support resources

records.name: Johnson County Public Library Community Resources Directory
records.description: JCPL-curated directory connecting Johnson County residents to food pantries, free meals, housing support, homelessness services, WIC, referral lines, and related community assistance.
records.availability_notes: JCPL compiles external providers and does not operate most listed services. Eligibility, hours, documentation requirements, and program status should be verified with each provider. Verified August 6, 2026.

records.name: Johnson County Public Library Basic Needs Assistance Directory
records.description: JCPL-curated guide to employment, unemployment, legal help, food, child care, housing, domestic violence, senior services, mental health, disability, health insurance, addiction treatment, and emergency supports.
records.availability_notes: The page aggregates external services and may retain legacy or time-limited listings. Current eligibility, funding, hours, crisis contacts, and application status must be verified directly with each provider. Verified August 6, 2026.

records.name: Johnson County Helpline
records.description: Information and referral service providing contact information and guidance for Johnson County residents seeking food, medical, housing, and other social-service resources.
records.availability_notes: Contact details and service coverage should be verified before referral. JCPL lists 317-738-4636. Verified August 6, 2026.

records.name: Interchurch Food Pantry of Johnson County
records.description: Faith-based food pantry serving Johnson County residents from its Franklin location.
records.availability_notes: JCPL notes that proof of Johnson County residency with picture identification is required. Hours and documentation rules should be verified before referral. Verified August 6, 2026.

records.name: Johnson County WIC
records.description: Local WIC program supporting eligible pregnant and postpartum women, infants, and children up to age five with nutrition services and family-health support.
records.availability_notes: Categorical eligibility includes pregnant and postpartum women, infants, and children through age five; income, residency, appointment, and documentation requirements should be confirmed. Verified August 6, 2026.

records.name: Johnson County Blessing Boxes
records.description: Mapped network of self-serve blessing boxes offering nonperishable food items across Johnson County.
records.availability_notes: Individual box locations and inventory can change without notice; users should check the current map and expect variable supply. Verified August 6, 2026.

records.name: KIC-IT
records.description: Franklin-based organization serving unhoused and housing-unstable youth ages 16 to 25 through a drop-in center, hot meals, case management, transportation, and related support.
records.availability_notes: Age eligibility, drop-in hours, transportation coverage, and current program capacity should be confirmed before referral. Verified August 6, 2026.

records.name: Johnson County Bar Association Legal Clinic
records.description: Free pop-up legal service for Johnson County residents offered at Greenwood Public Library and the Johnson County Courthouse Law Library in Franklin.
records.availability_notes: Clinic dates, locations, appointment rules, legal-topic coverage, and capacity are schedule-sensitive and should be verified before referral. JCPL lists 317-868-2589. Verified August 6, 2026.

records.name: ASSIST Indiana
records.description: Johnson County program serving people directly or indirectly affected by sexual, domestic, and physical violence.
records.availability_notes: Program availability, crisis response, confidentiality, service scope, and contact methods should be verified directly. JCPL lists 317-346-2720. Verified August 6, 2026.

records.name: Johnson County Senior Services
records.description: Nonprofit providing no-cost, door-to-door wheelchair-accessible transportation for Johnson County residents age 60 and older, plus durable medical equipment and a pantry of food and household items.
records.availability_notes: Transportation scheduling, geographic limits, age eligibility, equipment inventory, and pantry availability should be confirmed before referral. JCPL lists 317-738-4544. Verified August 6, 2026.

records.name: JCPL NaloxBoxes
records.description: Self-serve naloxone overdose-reversal kits available at JCPL locations through a partnership with Upstream Prevention and the Johnson County Health Department.
records.availability_notes: Kit stock can vary by branch. Naloxone is an emergency overdose-reversal tool and does not replace calling emergency services or obtaining medical care. Verified August 6, 2026.
